title: The BOMBAY PREVENTION OF BEGGING ACT, 1959
full_text: The BOMBAY PREVENTION OF BEGGING ACT, 1959 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195910 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 1969-06-02 Act Year: 1959 Short Title: The BOMBAY PREVENTION OF BEGGING ACT, 1959 Long Title: For the purpose of making uniform and better provisions for the prevention of begging in the State of Bombay; for the detention, training and employment of beggars and their dependents in certain institutions; for the custody, trial and punishment of beggar offenders and for these and other purposes it was proposed to enact a law. Accordingly the Bombay Prevention of Begging Bill was introduced in the Legislative Assembly.
